clauses.clause: {1}, {T}: Choose a card name, then reveal the top card of your library.
If that card has the chosen name, sacrifice this artifact and draw three cards.

mapping.notes: M8 mapper. Refused whole by the compiler's sorcery-gate fault; mapped whole. 'That card' is the revealed top card: comparison over number_in(<zone>) over Zone(LIBRARY, YOU, TOP) with NAME_CHOSEN (Conspicuous Snoop's top-card form). A bare NAME_CHOSEN Conditional would judge the Lockbox itself (executor._conditional_subject), which naming 'Diviner's Lockbox' would satisfy. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/M20/diviners_lockbox_*.json. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
